parameters.query: WITH candidate AS (SELECT id FROM findings WHERE id=$1::uuid AND $2 IN ('CONFIRMED','REJECTED','NEEDS_REVIEW','RESOLVED')), inserted AS (INSERT INTO reviews (finding_id,decision,comment,reviewer_id) SELECT id,$2,$3,'demo-user' FROM candidate RETURNING id,finding_id,decision,comment,created_at), changed AS (UPDATE findings SET status=$2,updated_at=now() WHERE id IN (SELECT finding_id FROM inserted) RETURNING id,status), audit AS (INSERT INTO audit_events (actor_type,actor_id,action,resource_type,resource_id,payload) SELECT 'USER','demo-user','FINDING_REVIEWED','finding',finding_id::text,jsonb_build_object('decision',decision) FROM inserted) SELECT inserted.id,inserted.finding_id,inserted.decision,inserted.comment,inserted.created_at,changed.status FROM inserted JOIN changed ON changed.id=inserted.finding_id
